title: 番外Ⅳ项羽传
content_zh:
祭天国的青蛙，话说看这个之前一定要记得祭奠天国的青蛙啊……
此战之后项羽才突然发现，天下英雄当真如狗，他想要碾死对方几乎没有丝毫的难度，自此项羽再无向人卑躬屈膝的时候，他就是王！
看着帐下不敢和自己对视，甚至自己看一眼都畏畏缩缩的盟友，在想想他们战前对于自己的推诿，项羽只想说一句如此的无趣！
时无英雄，竟使竖子称雄，如果项羽知道这句话的话绝对会嘲讽着说出来，这个时候的他已经没有丝毫的忌讳，他的力量依旧足够让他随心所欲了。
看着颤抖着给自己敬酒的那个将领，项羽随意的一扫，对方直接软到，浑身筛糠，项羽狂笑着站立了起来，他羞于和这些人同列，这就是当年自己叔父给自己介绍的英雄人物？
项羽大笑间出营，所到之处所有的盟友对其都是敬畏有加，但是真正敢和他站在一起人已经没有了，他手下的龙且，季布，钟离昧等人也不再像以前那么随意的将他看作少将军了。
就这样在所有人又敬又畏的那段时间里，项羽明白了什么是孤独，他终于明白为什么秦皇要称孤道寡，真正有能力抹杀掉任何一个人的权势，任何一个人的一切，大概别人都很难何其交心。
“将军，刘邦前来找您。”一个士卒对着项羽一礼说道，这个时候项羽已经具有的王的属性，至少人不敢亲近，正常也不会有人打扰。
“叫他来。”项羽随意的说道，对于刘邦他的印象并不多，只是在起兵的时候见到过，不过那都是过去了，还是那句话，时无英雄，竟使竖子称雄，在现在的项羽看来天下已经没有人可以和他推杯把盏了。
“喏！”传令兵告退，很快刘邦就过来了。
“项兄弟~”远远的就能听到刘邦的声音，对方一路小跑，神色自若的跑了过来。
项羽微怔，多久了都没人再敢和他称兄道弟了，那一战之后，他真正的感觉到了孤独。当初说是准备将妹妹嫁给自己，做自己小舅子的虞子期也绝口不提这话了，话说虞子期的妹妹到底是怎么样，项羽有时候孤独起来就会胡思乱想。
“项兄弟……”刘邦叫了两声项羽，发现没有反应于是伸手推了推。
“哎呦，我去，项老弟，我听人说你举起了一做山轰碎了巨鹿，还以为是玩笑，这力气还真不是开玩笑的。”刘邦被项羽本能反应，直接撞到在地，于是就坐在地上嬉皮笑脸的说道。
项羽看着刘邦那毫无惧色的笑脸，微微一愣，伸手准备将刘邦拉起来，结果刘邦笑了笑，“来来来，坐这里，咱也不站起来了，免得再被你撞一下，我这小身板顶不住老弟这伟力。”
“哈哈哈哈！”项羽大笑，这种话虽说在这段时间听了很多遍，但是只有这次刘邦说出来令他最舒服，其他的人总像是自己要杀他，说笑的样子就跟哭一样。
项羽随意的坐到地上，“刘三，几年没见，你也阔了啊，当年见你的时候风尘仆仆，现在倒是好了很多，怎么你小子不会又被人揍了，或者还是又有什么打不过的要我帮忙，说出来，我帮你一把！”
项羽这话是实话，是真的想要帮一把刘邦，他现在已经寂寞了，也孤独了，能遇到这么一个能说会道，而且还不怕自己的老乡，项羽也确实是惊奇。
“甭提了，我这次来是给你还兵的，当年还欠了令叔父五千兵马，这些年也一直没还，你也知道我这人就喜欢占人便宜，都不准备还了，但是听闻令叔父意外逝去，知道你需要所以准备还给你。”刘邦摆了摆手说道。
“结果回来的路上就得知项兄弟大破秦军，我也就回来看看，这五千兵马我不还给你没事吧。”刘邦看着项羽一脸希冀的说道，但就是没有畏惧。

“区区五千兵马而已！”项羽乐了，项梁的事情已经过去了，他也不愿意多想了，而且刘邦之前说的话也着实让他感动，在想想当时刘邦的位置，项羽叹了口气拍了拍刘邦的肩膀。
“项老弟，还请手下留情，我这脊背可不是巨鹿城墙啊。”刘邦的脸皱成一团，都快流眼泪了。
“哈哈哈哈！”项羽大笑，“刘三，我以前觉得你就是个流氓，没想到你居然如此有趣。”
“我也是这么觉得哈！”刘邦得意的大笑道，“走我带你去吃我最爱吃的狗肉，舒缓舒缓。”
话说项羽其实并不喜欢吃狗肉这种东西，但是和刘邦言谈甚欢，再加上现在算得上是唯一不怕自己的人物，于是也没多想就和刘邦出了自己楚军大营，当然现在项羽也不怕有人刺杀，什么墨家任侠第一高手，你能想象对着对方一声吼，对面直接被震得七窍流血而死。
项羽来到刘邦大营之后，就一个感觉，烂，太烂了，大军烂，铠甲烂，武器烂，什么都烂，士卒都是面黄肌瘦的或坐，或躺在营中，就连刘邦进来也没有多少反应，这能称上大军？难民吧！
看着那一小锅肉，刘邦一副按捺不住的表情，项羽就一个感觉，可怜，跟着刘邦将那一小锅肉吃完之后，刘邦的妻子吕雉，端着一壶酒上来。
对于这个女人，项羽惊艳了一把，不过随后得知对方是刘邦的妻子，当即目不转睛，继续和刘邦推杯把盏。
很快刘邦就喝的酩酊大醉，而项羽靠着那强横的实力根本没有任何的问题。
刘邦醉晕晕的搂着项羽的脖子，“这是我妻子吕雉，来来来，见过项兄弟，我顶好的兄弟。”
“相公既然和叔叔以兄弟相称，为何不结拜为兄弟？”吕雉突然问道，随后刘邦醉眼迷离，哈哈大笑道，“对对对……你这婆娘说的对……”
话说间刘邦就顺着项羽的脖子溜了下去，当即准备行礼，而项羽眼见刘邦如此行径，也是一愣，随后又觉得刘邦这人的确不错，有情有义，又不畏惧自己，于是也就顺着跪了下去。
就这样刘邦和项羽当夜抵足而眠，次日项羽又拉着刘邦过营，出营的时候又自觉自己过的这么好，不能让兄弟吃亏，又给送兵送粮送武器铠甲，刘邦自然是来者不拒，不过正如此项羽更加觉得刘邦这家伙是兄弟。
大概在项羽眼中，只有兄弟才不会畏惧自己，才会随意的接受自己的馈赠。
content_en:
Sacrificing the Frogs of Heaven. Before watching this, you must remember to pay homage to the Frogs of Heaven...
After this battle, Xiang Yu suddenly discovered that the heroes in the world are really like dogs. It is almost impossible for him to crush the opponent to death. From the moment Xiang Yu never kowtows to anyone again, he is the king!
Looking at his allies who dared not look at him, and who even shrank from looking at him, and thinking about the excuses they made for him before the war, Xiang Yu just wanted to say something so boring!
There was no hero at the time, but Zhuzi was the hero. If Xiang Yu knew this sentence, he would definitely say it sarcastically. At this time, he no longer had any taboos, and his power was still enough to let him do whatever he wanted.
Looking at the trembling general who was toasting him, Xiang Yu glanced at him casually. The general softened and was covered with chaff. Xiang Yu laughed wildly and stood up. He was ashamed to be in the same row as these people. Is this the hero his uncle introduced to him back then?
Xiang Yu left the camp while laughing, and all his allies were in awe of him wherever he went, but no one really dared to stand with him anymore, and his subordinates Long Qie, Ji Bu, Zhong Limei and others no longer regarded him as a major general as casually as before.
In this way, during the period when everyone was in awe and fear, Xiang Yu understood what loneliness was. He finally understood why Emperor Qin wanted to be called a loner, and he was truly capable of erasing anyone's power. It was probably difficult for others to relate to anything about anyone.
"General, Liu Bang has come to see you." A soldier saluted Xiang Yu. At this time, Xiang Yu already had the attributes of a king. At least no one dared to get close to him, and normally no one would disturb him.
"Ask him to come." Xiang Yu said casually. He didn't have much impression of Liu Bang. He only saw him when he raised his army, but that was all in the past. As the same saying goes, there are no heroes in the world, so the emperor was able to rule the roost. In Xiang Yu's eyes now, no one in the world can compete with him.
"Here!" The messenger resigned, and soon Liu Bang came over.
"Brother Xiang~" Liu Bang's voice could be heard in the distance, and he ran over with a calm look on his face.
Xiang Yu was slightly startled. It had been a long time since anyone dared to call him brother. After that battle, he really felt lonely. Yu Ziqi, who originally said that he planned to marry his sister to him and become his brother-in-law, never mentioned this. As for what Yu Ziqi's sister was like, Xiang Yu would sometimes have random thoughts when he was alone.
"Brother Xiang..." Liu Bang called Xiang Yu twice. When he found that there was no response, he reached out and pushed.
"Hey, let's go, brother Xiang, I heard someone said that you lifted a mountain and smashed a giant deer to pieces. I thought it was a joke. This strength is really not a joke." Liu Bang was knocked to the ground by Xiang Yu's instinctive reaction, so he sat on the ground and said with a playful smile.
Xiang Yu looked at Liu Bang's fearless smiling face and was slightly stunned. He stretched out his hand to pull Liu Bang up, but Liu Bang smiled and said, "Come on, come on, sit here, let's not stand up, so as not to be bumped by you again. My small body cannot withstand the power of my brother."
"Hahahaha!" Xiang Yu laughed. Although he had heard this kind of words many times during this period, Liu Bang was the only one who felt the most comfortable when he said it this time. Others always seemed to want to kill him, and they looked like they were crying when they were joking.
Xiang Yu casually sat on the ground and said, "Liu San, I haven't seen you for a few years, and you are rich now. When I met you, you were dusty, but you are much better now. Why won't your kid get beaten up again? Or there is still something you can't beat and you want my help. Tell me and I will help you!"
Xiang Yu is telling the truth, he really wants to help Liu Bang. He is lonely now, and he is lonely. Xiang Yu is really surprised to meet such a well-spoken fellow who is not afraid of him.
"Don't mention it, I'm here to fight back for you.I owed Uncle Ling five thousand troops and horses last year, and I have not paid it back all these years. You also know that I like to take advantage of others, and I am not ready to pay it back. But I heard that Uncle Ling passed away unexpectedly, and I know you need it, so I am ready to pay it back to you. Liu Bang waved his hand and said.
"On the way back, I learned that Brother Xiang had defeated the Qin army, so I came back to have a look. Is it okay if I don't return these five thousand troops to you? Liu Bang looked at Xiang Yu and said with hope, but he was not afraid.
“It’s just five thousand soldiers and horses! "Xiang Yu was happy. Xiang Liang's matter was over, and he didn't want to think about it anymore. Moreover, what Liu Bang said before really moved him. Thinking about Liu Bang's position at that time, Xiang Yu sighed and patted Liu Bang's shoulder.
"Brother Xiang, please be merciful, my back is not the wall of a giant deer. "Liu Bang's face wrinkled up and he was about to cry.
“Hahahaha! Xiang Yu laughed, "Liu San, I used to think you were just a gangster, but I didn't expect you to be so interesting." "
"I think so too! Liu Bang laughed proudly and said, "Come on, I will take you to eat my favorite dog meat, it will be soothing." "
It is said that Xiang Yu actually doesn't like eating dog meat, but he had a good conversation with Liu Bang, and now he is the only person who is not afraid of himself, so he and Liu Bang left the Chu army camp without much thought. Of course, Xiang Yu is not afraid of assassination now. The top master of Ren Xia in the Mohist family, you can imagine that if you yell at the opponent, the opponent will be shocked to the point of bleeding to death.
After Xiang Yu came to Liu Bang's camp, he had a feeling, it was rotten, it was too rotten. The army was rotten, the armor was rotten, the weapons were rotten, everything was rotten. The soldiers were all sallow and thin, sitting or lying in the camp. Even Liu Bang didn't react much when he came in. Can this be called a big army? Be a refugee!
Looking at the small pot of meat, Liu Bang had an uncontrollable expression, and Xiang Yu felt pitiful. After Liu Bang finished eating the small pot of meat, Liu Bang's wife, Lu Fei, came up with a pot of wine.
Xiang Yu was stunned by this woman, but then he learned that she was Liu Bang's wife. He immediately stared at her and continued to drink with Liu Bang.
Liu Bang soon became very drunk, but Xiang Yu had no problems at all with his tyrannical strength.
Liu Bang hugged Xiang Yu's neck in a drunken state, "This is my wife Lu Pheasant. Come, come, come, I've met Brother Xiang, my best brother. "
"Since my husband and my uncle are called brothers, why don't we become brothers? " Lu Pheasant suddenly asked, and then Liu Bang was drunk and blurred, and laughed loudly, "Yes, yes... you are right, mother-in-law..."
As soon as he said this, Liu Bang slipped down Xiang Yu's neck and was about to salute. Xiang Yu was stunned when he saw Liu Bang behaving like this. Then he felt that Liu Bang was indeed a good person, kind and righteous, and not afraid of himself, so he knelt down.
In this way, Liu Bang and Xiang Yu slept together that night. The next day, Xiang Yu took Liu Bang to the camp again. When he left the camp, he felt that he was living so well and could not let his brother suffer. He also sent troops, food, weapons and armor. Naturally, Liu Bang did not refuse anyone who came, but just like Xiang Yu, he felt that Liu Bang was a brother.
Probably in Xiang Yu's eyes, only brothers will not be afraid of him and will accept his gifts at will.
